agent_response.case_narrative: Around 1733649309, ts-auth-service experienced a sudden extreme memory surge (+672%) and CPU spike (+245%), with anomalous INFO logs and socket increase, indicating internal fault. TokenException errors erupted across entry and mid-tier services (ts-assurance-service, ts-admin-travel-service, ts-food-service, ts-travel2-service, ts-travel-service), peaking 40-90s later. IVD labels ts-auth-service as the initiator, with highest Copeland score and own-code stack trace. Downstream components show reactive resource pressure or late error spikes, consistent with auth failure causing timeout/exception cascades. ts-travel2-service has ambiguous IVD status despite high resource magnitude, and its dominant error spike comes 75s after onset, suggesting victim. The main uncertainty is whether ts-auth-service's anomaly is self-contained or triggered by a dependency; need to verify it explains all downstream symptoms and rule out travel2-first story.
